intro: Christchurch's gym market has seen significant growth since the post-quake rebuild, with City Fitness being a dominant player. However, other options like 24/7 gyms have also gained popularity. With prices ranging from $15 to $40 per week, Kiwis have a wide range of choices. As of May 2026, the market continues to evolve with new facilities and services.

sections.heading: Gym Prices in Christchurch
sections.body: When it comes to gym prices in Christchurch, members can expect to pay between $15 and $40 per week. City Fitness offers a 12-month contract for $24.95 per week, while 24/7 gyms like Jetts and Anytime Fitness offer more flexible contract terms, with prices starting from $15 per week.

sections.heading: 24/7 Gym Options
sections.body: For those who prefer to work out at odd hours, 24/7 gyms like Jetts and Anytime Fitness offer a convenient solution. With prices starting from $15 per week and no contract terms, these gyms are ideal for students, shift workers, or anyone who prefers flexibility.
